name: Rendezvous Barbers
suits: a shop with a strong colour of its own and a young, fashion-led clientele
moves: one loud brand colour as the whole ground instead of a photograph behind the hero
an editorial serif headline with half the sentence in italic
video in a rounded frame that opens up as the page scrolls; the book button fixed bottom right

name: Porem Barbershop
suits: any business whose pitch is the booking — two shops, a short menu, walk-ins
moves: the booking in the hero: choose the shop, then the service with its price and length, then «check availability»
the rating line and a strip of reviews right under the first screen
service tiles with a photograph each and a «most popular» / «best deal» tag

name: Hagi's
award: Awwwards SOTD 2021 (the site has been redesigned since)
suits: a classic, heritage shop with a strong interior
moves: a quiet, centred serif statement on a light ground with one button
a dark band with photographs overlapping each other — the overlap composition
the locations in the header beside booking

name: Atelier Brzozowski
suits: a salon with editorial portraits and a founder's name on the door
moves: the name in a huge display serif over a full-screen portrait
a short manifesto in a narrow column beside the founding year
one warm grade across every photograph

name: Venetian Nail Spa
suits: nails, brows, lashes, spa — close-up, hand-led work
moves: a thin serif in capitals over a close-up of hands
arched frames for photographs, soft gold as the one accent
a phone hero composed for the phone, not squeezed from the laptop

name: M / Coupe
suits: a salon with black-and-white portraits and a short name
moves: a black-and-white photograph with the wordmark the full width beneath it
a minimal header with one outlined booking button
almost nothing else: it works by scale alone

name: HYPE Tattoo
suits: a studio of several artists where the crew is the brand
moves: the whole team in one photograph as the hero — the people are the product
a hand-drawn scribble over the headline
one cyan accent, on the consultation button only

name: Muchacha
suits: a place with atmosphere — evenings, a room people come for
moves: a huge wordmark over an atmospheric photograph, with a strip of thumbnails in the hero (our stage gallery)
the opening hours as a running line
handwritten notes in the margins

name: Restaurant Zimmerl
suits: a high-end, precise business with one person at its centre
moves: deep green and gold, a thin serif
a number as the heading — «23 Gänge» (the numbers composition)
the chef's portrait with text, photographs of the work offset from each other

name: Sunbeam Bagels
suits: a friendly, everyday place with a warm room
moves: a chunky retro serif over a photograph of the room
the opening hours in the header itself
a floating pill menu at the bottom of the screen; cut-out products on a bright band

name: Sqew
suits: a loud, casual business with two or three locations
moves: extra-condensed capitals on a textured, saturated ground
cut-out product photographs breaking out of the frame
three header buttons: opening times, find us, order

name: Escape Coffee
suits: a business with an attitude and one line it lives by
moves: a huge condensed slogan over a dark, moody photograph
a vertical rail at the side of the page
product cards with their particulars as a table — close to our ledger

name: Bernice
suits: a playful business whose product photographs well from above
moves: a heavy grotesque over a flat-lay seen from above
a rotating round badge as the button
product cards over running words

name: AlpineCore
suits: a studio, a practice, anything calm — and the Swiss market
moves: a landscape in the hero with thin, elegant type
topographic lines as a quiet ground
a small inset photograph beside the list of sections

name: Yogamaya
suits: a business with many offers and a strong typographic identity
moves: the menu is the hero: the sections in a giant condensed serif
a line drawing behind the letters
a running ribbon with the next courses

name: Aventura Dental Arts
suits: a practitioner people trust as a person — clinic, therapist, master
moves: a condensed serif headline running across a photograph of the practitioner at work
trust through the person, not through icons
a tidy header: the form, the phone, the booking
